source.provenanceNotes: Separate owner prototype. Published frozen legacy renderer dependency plus pinned external common procedural art v0.5. Old games/demos and QUALITY-01 remain unchanged. No commercial ROM, extracted reference payload, credentials, or large movies published.

capabilities.hiddenSurfaceMethod: backface rejection and painter sorting in local images; far-to-near foreground objects; NO per-pixel background depth mask
